ankle.en: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.

union.en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.

abundant.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
abundant.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。

spear.en: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
spear.zh: 矛尖浸在一種致命的毒藥裡。

inn.en: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
inn.zh: 火警發生在他們住的旅館。

unconscious.en: He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.
unconscious.zh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

avenue.en: I'd like to do shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
avenue.zh: 我想在紐約的第五大道購物。

bare.en: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
bare.zh: 空手赤拳抓野兔並不容易。

however.en: She looks young. However, she's actually over forty.
however.zh: 她看起来是年轻的，但实际上她四十多岁了。

camel.en: The camel can go a long time without water and food.
camel.zh: 駱駝可以撐很久不吃不喝。

connect.en: Do you feel like you can't connect with other people?
connect.zh: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？

basement.en: I know I left it somewhere down here in the basement.
basement.zh: 我知道我把它放在地下室的某個地方了。

arrange.en: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
arrange.zh: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。

tendency.en: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
tendency.zh: 在我看來，她有一種誇張的傾向。

pin.en: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.
pin.zh: 安靜到連針掉在地上的聲音你都會聽得到。

contrary.en: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.
contrary.zh: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。

characteristic.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.

chalk.en: Take this piece of chalk and write on the blackboard.
chalk.zh: 拿起這支粉筆，在黑板上寫字。

twentieth.en: The next meeting will be on the twentieth of October.

bay.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
bay.zh: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。

tomb.en: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.

statistics.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
statistics.zh: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。

technology.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
technology.zh: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。

replace.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
replace.zh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

printer.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
printer.zh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

direct.en: Are there any direct flights between Boston and Sydney?
direct.zh: 请问波士顿和悉尼之间有直飞航班吗？

dash.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
dash.zh: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界紀錄。

collar.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
collar.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

disadvantage.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.

obtain.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
obtain.zh: 他們在這次的投資中得到百分之八的收益。

wrinkle.en: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
wrinkle.zh: 你想要知道如何避免皺紋嗎？

twenty-one.en: My sister is twenty-one years old and a college student.

tick.en: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.
tick.zh: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。

mercy.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
mercy.zh: 可憐的人民任憑殘暴的獨裁者處置。

punctuation.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
punctuation.zh: 你得要更注意拼字和標點符號。

download.en: If you do not have this program, you can download it now.
download.zh: 假如你没有这个程序，你现在就可以去下载。

shabby.en: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.
shabby.zh: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。

festival.en: The date of the festival coincides with that of the exam.
festival.zh: 节日和考试碰巧在同一天。

sacrifice.en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
sacrifice.zh: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

bowling.en: Although I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
bowling.zh: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。

welfare.en: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
welfare.zh: 法國是一個福利國家，但它卻不再能夠負擔得起了。

australian.en: Indigenous Australians have eaten kangaroos for millennia.
australian.zh: 澳大利亚土著已经吃了上千年袋鼠。

kangaroo.en: Indigenous Australians have eaten kangaroos for millennia.
kangaroo.zh: 澳大利亚土著已经吃了上千年袋鼠。

boom.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
boom.zh: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

refreshments.en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
refreshments.zh: 茶点过后我们接着开会。

playground.en: A group of young men are playing handball in the playground.
playground.zh: 一群年輕人在操場上打手球。

male.en: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
male.zh: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。

fried.en: On the table, there was a plate with three fried eggs on it.
fried.zh: 桌子上放著一個盤子，上面放著三顆煎蛋。

radiation.en: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
radiation.zh: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

grandparents.en: Tom went to Boston to spend Christmas with his grandparents.
grandparents.zh: 湯姆去波士頓陪爺爺奶奶過聖誕節。

lifetime.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。

conventional.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
conventional.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。

twelfth.en: The old church on the hill dates back to the twelfth century.
twelfth.zh: 山上的老教堂的歷史可以追溯到12世紀。

shark.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
shark.zh: 鯊魚皮比金槍魚皮粗糙多了。

right-handed.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
right-handed.zh: 這把剪刀左右撇子都適用。

circus.en: At the age of six, I was taken to a circus for the first time.
circus.zh: 在我六岁的时候，我第一次被带去看马戏。

symphony.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
symphony.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

shaver.en: I should have tried out this electric shaver before buying it.
shaver.zh: 我本该在买下这个电动剃须刀之前试一下的。

wag.en: We're on strike because the company hasn't improved our wages.
wag.zh: 我們罷工是因為公司沒有改善我們的工資。

recite.en: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.

injure.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
injure.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

universal.en: English is a universal language and is used all over the world.
universal.zh: 英語是一種世界性的語言，用於世界各地。

abnormal.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
abnormal.zh: 環境污染正造成異常的天氣情況。

chemical.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
chemical.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

oneself.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
oneself.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

microscope.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
microscope.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

telescope.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
telescope.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

fourteen.en: My father died of a subarachnoid hemorrhage when I was fourteen.
fourteen.zh: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。

conflict.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
conflict.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

vest.en: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
vest.zh: 湯姆穿著一件防彈衣，所以子彈沒把他殺死。

champion.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
champion.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

traveler.en: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
traveler.zh: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

starve.en: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
starve.zh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

punishment.en: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
punishment.zh: 在一些國家，叛國罪的懲罰可以是終身監禁。

settlement.en: On this small island are two large towns and many small settlements.
settlement.zh: 這個小島上有兩座大城市及許多小村鎮。

flash.en: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
flash.zh: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。

unemployment.en: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
unemployment.zh: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

boxing.en: Tom wants to learn boxing, but his mother thinks it's too dangerous.
boxing.zh: 汤姆想学拳击，但他妈妈觉得这太危险了。

disagreement.en: It's clear that there's a rather strong disagreement between the two.
disagreement.zh: 很明顯的是這兩者之間有很強烈的分歧。

laser.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
laser.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

actual.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
actual.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

outline.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
outline.zh: 線條藝術強調形式和輪廓，而不是顏色、陰影和紋理。

empire.en: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
empire.zh: 紐約帝國大廈現在完全依靠風力發電。

joy.en: Her eyes shone with joy when she saw that her mother was not mad at her.
joy.zh: 當她看到媽媽沒在生她的氣，她的雙眼因為幸福而閃爍了。

possess.en: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
possess.zh: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

anniversary.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
anniversary.zh: 湯姆從沒忘記在婚禮周年紀念日送給他妻子花。

network.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
network.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

electronic.en: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
electronic.zh: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

apron.en: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
apron.zh: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

british.en: The population of London is much greater than that of any other British city.
british.zh: 倫敦的人口遠遠多於其他英國城市的人口。

atlantic.en: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
atlantic.zh: Charles Lindbergh於1927年成功完成了第一次獨自飛越大西洋。

scores.en: His scores are always better than mine, even though he doesn't study very much.
scores.zh: 他的分数总比我高，尽管他学习得少一点。

operator.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
operator.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
